meta.title: Pillbox Pods — launch
meta.description: Launch of Pillbox Pods: pharmacy-filled pill pods that light up at dose time, text a caregiver after a missed dose and reorder before they run out.

slides.heading: Every pill on time, without the Sunday sorting ritual.
slides.lead: Pillbox Pods go on sale 12 January 2027.
slides.notes: One sentence, then a pause. Inês's quote does the work on the next slide.

slides.quote: I sort fourteen pills every Sunday night, and I still can't tell if Dad took his noon dose.
slides.by: Inês Faria, cares for her father in Porto · pilot participant

slides.heading: Pillbox Pods
slides.lead: Snap-together pods that light up at dose time and log every opening.

slides.heading: How it works
slides.lead: Three jobs a plain weekly box cannot do.

slides.heading: Each pod glows at dose time and goes dark once you take it
slides.body:
Your pharmacy pre-fills one pod per dose.
The ring glows for 30 minutes.
Lift the lid and the dose is logged.
slides.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 600 520'><rect width='600' height='520' fill='%23FFFFFF'/><circle cx='300' cy='240' r='190' fill='%23E85D4E' opacity='.12'/><rect x='150' y='90' width='300' height='300' rx='80' fill='%23F5F5F0' stroke='%231E1E1E' stroke-width='8'/><circle cx='300' cy='240' r='96' fill='none' stroke='%23E85D4E' stroke-width='22'/><circle cx='300' cy='240' r='58' fill='%23E85D4E' stroke='%231E1E1E' stroke-width='6'/><g font-family='Helvetica,Arial' text-anchor='middle' fill='%231E1E1E'><text x='300' y='440' font-size='34' font-weight='bold'>08:00 · Metformin 500 mg</text><text x='300' y='482' font-size='24' fill='%235A5A5A'>glowing until 08:30</text></g></svg>
slides.imageAlt: Top view of one pod: a coral light ring glows around the lid, labelled 08:00, Metformin 500 mg, glowing until 08:30.

slides.heading: A missed dose texts your caregiver within 30 minutes
slides.lead: No app on their side. One text with the pill name and the time.
slides.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 25 1600 400'><rect width='1600' height='500' fill='%23C4D94E'/><text x='880' y='92' font-family='Helvetica,Arial' font-size='22' fill='%231E1E1E'>Pillbox · text message · 13:30</text><rect x='880' y='110' width='560' height='200' rx='34' fill='%23FFFFFF' stroke='%231E1E1E' stroke-width='5'/><g font-family='Helvetica,Arial' font-size='30' fill='%231E1E1E'><text x='914' y='162' font-weight='bold'>Dad's 13:00 dose</text><text x='914' y='204'>Lisinopril 10 mg is not taken yet.</text></g><rect x='1180' y='236' width='230' height='56' rx='28' fill='%23E85D4E'/><text x='1295' y='273' font-family='Helvetica,Arial' font-size='24' fill='%23FFFFFF' text-anchor='middle'>Call Dad</text></svg>
slides.imageAlt: A phone on a lime background shows a text from Pillbox at 13:30: Dad's 13:00 dose, Lisinopril 10 mg, is not taken yet.

slides.heading: Refill pods arrive from your pharmacy before the last one empties
slides.body:
The hub counts the doses left.
At five days left, it orders the next set.
Empty pods go back in the same box.
slides.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 600 520'><rect width='600' height='520' fill='%23FFFFFF'/><rect x='60' y='120' width='480' height='120' rx='60' fill='%231E1E1E'/><text x='300' y='196' font-family='Helvetica,Arial' font-size='44' fill='%23C4D94E' text-anchor='middle' font-weight='bold'>5 days left</text><rect x='130' y='300' width='340' height='150' rx='20' fill='%23F5F5F0' stroke='%231E1E1E' stroke-width='6'/><path d='M130 350 H470' stroke='%231E1E1E' stroke-width='4'/><g font-family='Helvetica,Arial' fill='%231E1E1E' text-anchor='middle'><text x='300' y='336' font-size='24' font-weight='bold'>Refill ordered</text><text x='300' y='400' font-size='24'>21 pods · Farmácia Central</text><text x='300' y='432' font-size='22' fill='%235A5A5A'>arrives Thursday</text></g></svg>
slides.imageAlt: The hub display reads 5 days left; below it a parcel label says refill ordered, 21 pods from Farmácia Central, arrives Thursday.

slides.heading: Pilot adherence held at 94% for 12 weeks, against 71% with plain boxes
slides.lead: Doses taken on time, %. Pilot with adults on 4+ daily medicines, Jun–Sep 2026: Pods n = 1,140, plain box n = 380.
slides.notes: Point at week 12: the plain box drifts down, the pods stay flat. That gap is the product.

slides.quote: Dad hasn't missed a noon dose since August. I stopped calling him at lunch to check.
slides.by: Inês Faria, twelve weeks into the pilot
